chunks: From him, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Muḥammad ibn Marwān, from Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:

I said to Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: A man dies while traveling with women, and there is no man with them; what should they do with him? He said: “They should wrap him up completely in his clothes and bury him, and they should not give him ghusl.”

key_terms.يُغَسِّلْنَهُ: they should wash him with ghusl

ai.seo_question: What should women do if a man dies while traveling with them and no male is present to wash his body?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for the case in which a man dies during travel while only women are present and no man is with them. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that they should wrap him in his clothes and bury him without performing ghusl, indicating a ruling tied to the limits of handling the deceased across gender lines.
